verdict.rationale: Keycloak's admin guide explicitly documents WebAuthn/passkey support as first-class sign-in options, including passwordless 'LoginLess WebAuthn', Conditional UI/autofill passkeys, Modal UI, and Passkey Mediation, giving strong first-party evidence for passkey/WebAuthn sign-in. However, there is no evidence in the pack of magic-link or email-OTP sign-in flows being offered as alternatives — only TOTP-based two-factor mentions and account console 2FA setup appear. Missing for 10: documented magic-link authentication flow, documented email-OTP as a sign-in method, and independent/hands-on confirmation that passkey flows work in practice.
